valuation.basis: current market cap vs the interim period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
